name: Montana State University Billings (Mountain State Poll)
sponsor: self (MSU Billings Office of the Provost, College of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences, Dept. of Social Sciences and Cultural Studies)

poll.source_locator: Q12 'which of the following candidates would you choose to support for US House Representative in District 1? (+/- 5.78%)' Total column: Aaron Flint (R) 32%, Sam Forstag (D) 49%, Nick Sheedy (L) 4%, Don't know 11%
poll.notes: District 1 subsample of a 720-response statewide poll (129 RDD phone, 591 online quota via Centiment), Oct 5-21. District n not printed; USPOLLINGDATA LISTS n=287 (consistent with the stated +/-5.78% MOE), left null. Daily Montanan (Oct 29) says the poll did not screen for registered or likely voters, so pop=A. other = Sheedy 4. release_date = PDF creation/last-modified date Oct 27 2026; Daily Montanan Oct 29 says 'released this week'.

pollster.weighting_quote: Responses are weighted according to Montana census data.
pollster.mode: random digit dial phone (Scientific Telephone Samples) plus online quota sample (Centiment)
